name: navbar
title: Navbar
description: Top app bar with a brand logo, links, icons, buttons, an extended row, sticky positioning and a search field.
improvements: Links live in a labelled nav landmark, and the active link has aria-current="page".
Flexbox layout instead of floats and an absolutely positioned logo, so links never overlap the brand.
Focus rings are drawn in the bar's text color, so they stay visible on any background.
The search field has a real label, clears on Escape or with a labelled button, and works controlled or uncontrolled.
The menu button is a real button that passes aria-expanded and aria-controls to your side navigation.
